snippet.title: Lightners Live Plus - Deltarune Fangame - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
MY LIGHTNERS LIVE PLUS FANGAME IS OUT NOW!!! HERE'S THE LINK: https://ezioeagle.itch.io/lightners-live-plus
Play a full recreation of the Ch3 rhythm game with 30 maps in your browser!
I've been working on this since a few days after the Ch3&4 trailer came out, and I'm very happy to release it now, before Ch3&4!

Also, this release coincided with me hitting 1000 subscribers, thank you so much! I wrote a separate little update post, here it is: https://www.youtube.com/post/Ugkx-boHzeXd37jMvaHtaz_krI1yGwgOta7T

My Patreon: https://patreon.com/EzioEagle 
My Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/ezioeagle.bsky.social
My Twitter: https://twitter.com/EzioEagle21
My Ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/ezioeagle
